title: Social Media and Depression Symptoms: A Network Perspective
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-person network
limitations: - Student sample (non-clinical); - Potential recall bias; - Self-reported PSMU may not reflect actual use; - Data not fully meeting multivariate normality assumptions; - No formal test for centrality differences; - Limited age range; - No logistic regression for non-normal data.
notes: The paper does not provide a DOI. The authors state that data, materials, and code are available in the Supplementary Materials. Preregistration status is not explicitly mentioned, but the authors note that the study design was discussed in lab meetings and orally presented, which may imply informal preregistration. The network estimation used mlVAR, and the authors consulted with the package author to resolve issues with between-subjects correlations.
